Question #: 1.Title: Exam E20-893 topic 1 question 7 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: You are assisting a Dell EMC NetWorker backup administrator in configuring a workflow to run an image backup of a VMware virtual machine. What should be configured?
A. VMware group type and workflow with Backup VMware action
B. Client for the VM, VMware group type, and workflow with Backup Traditional action
C. Client group type and workflow with Backup VMware action
D. Client for the VM, Clients group type, and workflow with Backup VMware action
Suggested Answer: B 🗳️

Question #: 2.Title: Exam E20-893 topic 1 question 12 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: A Dell EMC NetWorker administrator wants to perform a recovery of Microsoft Exchange server data. The administrator wants to retain all existing Exchange transactions that have occurred since the last backup. Current Exchange transaction logs are available.
What should be selected from "Recovery Options" within NMM?
A. Point-in-time recovery
B. RDB data recovery
C. Granular level recovery
D. Roll-forward recovery
Suggested Answer: C 🗳️

Question #: 3.Title: Exam E20-893 topic 1 question 13 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: A Dell EMC NetWorker backup administrator just installed a NetWorker Virtual Edition (NVE) server in their environment. The administrator wants to maximize performance of the NVE for initial backups.
Which configuration of the virtual disks will result in better initial performance?
A. Thin Provision
B. Thick Provision Lazy Zeroed
C. NFS datastore
D. Thick Provision Eager Zeroed
Suggested Answer: D 🗳️
Virtual disks for the Thick Provision Eager Zeroed, you will get better initial performance.

Question #: 4.Title: Exam E20-893 topic 1 question 15 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: A Dell EMC NetWorker administrator is protecting a VMware vCenter environment using multiple vProxies. The administrator received a request to start protecting a new vCenter. The administrator discovers the new vCenter in NetWorker. However, the NetWorker Policy Action wizard for the new vCenter does not show any vProxies available for selection.
What is the cause of this issue?
A. vProxies are limited to specific vCenters
B. Five minutes has not elapsed for the first vCenter vProxies to be discovered
C. NetWorker service nsrd must be restarted
D. New vCenter virtual machines are not supported for backup
Suggested Answer: C 🗳️
